query: 重要性（Materiality）评估 重要性（Materiality）评估 衡量企业识别并优先管理重大ESG议题的能力。 2分：采用了双重重要性原则（同时考虑财务影响与对环境/社会的影响）；详细披露了利益相关方参与的具体数据；议题与公司战略、KPI挂钩。 1分：披露了评估流程（如发放调查问卷），并提供了重要性矩阵 (Materiality Matrix)，但缺乏动态调整或双重重要性（Double Materiality）的思考。 0分：未披露重要性评估过程，或仅列出议题清单，未解释议题是如何选出的，无矩阵或排名。 重要性评估 实质性议题 重要性矩阵 双重重要性 利益相关方参与 议题排序 影响重要性 财务重要性 Double Materiality materiality assessment material topics materiality matrix double materiality stakeholder engagement issue prioritization impact materiality financial materiality Double Materiality 重要性评估流程如何开展？ 利益相关方如何参与及是否有具体数据？ 是否提供重要性矩阵或议题排名？ 是否采用双重重要性？ 重大议题是否与战略/KPI挂钩并动态调整？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '重要性（Materiality）评估'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 重要性评估流程如何开展？ 利益相关方如何参与及是否有具体数据？ 是否提供重要性矩阵或议题排名？ 是否采用双重重要性？ 重大议题是否与战略/KPI挂钩并动态调整？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅列出ESG议题清单无筛选过程；仅有社区需求调查；仅有气候风险清单；仅有GRI内容索引无评估方法；区分：重要性评估是公司级ESG议题优先排序；社区参与是社区关系战略；社会影响评估是项目社会后果评估；TCFD是气候披露框架。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: 為更好落實本集團的各項 ESG 相關政策,保 障 ESG 工作的有效、有序開展,我們針對各子 公司開展 ESG 績效考核,根據集團運營情況將 ESG 管理工作納入子公司的年度績效考核目 標,設置考核機制,對收集提報的數據及資 料的完整性、準確性、及時性進行評估,將績 效考核情況一併納入相關數據提供部門及負 責人的考核結果。我們通過推廣 ESG 績效考核 機制持續推進數據常態化收集,不斷完善本 集團的 ESG 管理機制,為 ESG 日常管理工作提 供有力支撐。

results.section: 利益相關方參與 / Stakeholders Engagement
results.text: Compared with 2020, the Group's internal and external stakeholders still regarded product safety and quality, protection of employee rights and interests, anti-corruption and internal control management, customer information security and privacy protection as material issues of the Group in terms of sustainable development in 2021. The Group will elaborate on the core issues in the following sections as a response to stakeholders' concerns and expectations.

results.section: 責任治理，可持續運營 Responsible Governance, Sustainable Operation / ESG Performance Appraisal
results.text: In order to better implement various ESG-related policies of the Group and ensure the effective and orderly implementation of the ESG work, we conduct ESG performance appraisal for our subsidiaries, and incorporate ESG management into the annual performance appraisal targets of subsidiaries according to the Group's operation. We set up an appraisal mechanism to assess the completeness, accuracy and timeliness of data and information collected and reported, and include the performance appraisal results in the appraisal results of relevant departments and responsible persons who provide data. By promoting the ESG performance appraisal mechanism, we continue to promote the regular collection of data and improve the Group's ESG management mechanism, so as to provide strong support for the daily management of ESG.
